name: Presheaf.IsSheaf.section_ext
statement: TopCat.{u}} {A : Type*} [Category.{u} A] {FC : A → A → Type*} {CC : A → Type u} [∀ X Y : A, FunLike (FC X Y) (CC X) (CC Y)] [ConcreteCategory.{u} A FC] [HasLimits A] [PreservesLimits (forget A)] [(forget A).ReflectsIsomorphisms] {F : TopCat.Presheaf A X} (hF : TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf F) {U : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ} {s t : ToType (F.obj U)} (hst : ∀ x ∈ U.unop, ∃ V, ∃ hV : V ≤ U.unop, x ∈ V ∧ F.map (homOfLE hV).op s = F.map (homOfLE hV).op t) : s = t
